arrangement.notes: Sparse verses emphasizing strong hooks with cinematic textures.

sound_intent.texture_bed: Create ambient cinematic atmosphere with layered samples and granular synthesis.
sound_intent.one_shot_hits: Use punchy percussive one-shot samples sliced and processed for dynamic impact.
sound_intent.vocals: Emphasize sparse, rhythmic verses contrasted with catchy and melodic hooks.

routing_intent.drums: Processed through transient shaper and parallel compression to preserve punch.
routing_intent.bass: Direct routed with mild saturation for warmth and presence.
routing_intent.chords: Sent through stereo reverb to add space and depth to the arrangement.
routing_intent.melody: Layered with subtle delays and modulation to enhance cinematic feel.
routing_intent.vocal: Dry/wet routing to maintain clarity in verses with subtle effects in hooks.
routing_intent.fx: Automated volume and filters to highlight section transitions.

track_roles.drums: provide rhythmic backbone with sample slicing techniques
track_roles.bass: foundation of groove with sample loop slices and subtle saturation
track_roles.chords: ambient texture created via granular pad samples
track_roles.melody: cinematic melodic fragments with sparse usage
track_roles.vocal: sparse verses with strong melodic hooks
track_roles.fx: transitional and atmospheric support using glitch and reverse samples

designer_intent.arrangement: Highlight the contrast between sparse verses and strong, catchy hooks through dynamic variation and cinematic textures.
designer_intent.texture: Blend sample-based pads and one-shot samples to achieve authentic West Coast hip-hop feel with modern cinematic influence.

presetor_intent.processing: Prioritize punchy transient shaping for drums and warm saturation for bass, maintaining clarity on vocals.
presetor_intent.effects: Use reverb and delay selectively to add space without cluttering the mix.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate and sequence drum patterns using sliced samples and one-shot hits focusing on punchy, sparse verses and powerful hooks.

bass_generator.brief: Create groovy bass lines based on loop slices with controlled saturation to complement the sparse verses and energetic hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Design atmospheric chord layers using granular pad samples to support the cinematic mood throughout the track.

melody_generator.brief: Compose minimal melodic elements for hooks and accents that enhance cinematic feel while maintaining sparseness.

ai_designer.brief: Arrange sparse verses and strong hooks with dynamic energy curve and cinematic textures, applying sound and routing intents.

presetor.brief: Apply processing presets focusing on transient shaping, saturation, and ambient effects as defined in sound and routing intents.

songgps.brief: Ensure arrangement conforms to mainstream West Coast hip-hop structure with cinematic mood and energy management.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix processing with emphasis on unprocessed audio delivery, allowing clear separation of sparse verses and strong hooks.
